import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
CANDIDATE = HERE / 'worktree'
KIT = ROOT / '.deps/rtl/oss-cad-suite/share/verilator/include'
DRIVER = HERE / 'isolated.cpp'
reports = {}
for label, tree in [('baseline', ROOT), ('candidate', CANDIDATE)]:
    obj = tree / 'build/tang20k-core-sim/obj'
    executable = HERE / (label + '-isolated.exe')
    objects = [obj / (name + '.o') for name in
               ('setup', 'renderer', 'demo', 'hw_protocol', 'sdram_model',
                'verilated', 'verilated_dpi', 'verilated_vcd_c', 'verilated_threads')]
    command = ['g++', '-std=c++17', '-O2', '-pthread', '-DVL_TIME_CONTEXT=1',
               '-DNANO_GPU_ORACLE_ONLY=1', '-DNANO_GPU_BOARD_PROFILE=1',
               '-DVM_TRACE=1', '-DVM_TRACE_VCD=1', '-DVM_TRACE_FST=0',
               '-I' + str(obj), '-I' + str(KIT), '-I' + str(KIT / 'vltstd'),
               '-I' + str(CANDIDATE / 'reference/include'), '-I' + str(CANDIDATE / 'reference/rtl'),
               str(DRIVER)] + list(map(str, objects)) + [str(obj / 'Vnano_gpu_core__ALL.a'), '-o', str(executable)]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)
    cases = []
    for name in ('ico', 'closeup', 'showcase', 'perspective', 'overdraw', 'opaque', 'vertex0', 'vertex1'):
        for delay in ((0, 12345, 160000, 700000) if name in ('ico', 'closeup') else (0, 700000)):
            path = HERE / (label + '-isolated-' + name + '-' + str(delay) + '.json')
            subprocess.run([str(executable), name, str(delay), str(path)], check=True)
            cases.append(json.loads(path.read_text()))
    reports[label] = {'executable_sha256': hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      'rtl_build_report': json.loads((obj.parent / 'build-report.json').read_text()),
                      'cases': cases}
comparisons = []
for before, after in zip(reports['baseline']['cases'], reports['candidate']['cases']):
    for key in ('case', 'idle_cycles', 'initial_core_cycle', 'initial_video_x', 'initial_video_y', 'initial_sdram_refreshes'):
        if before[key] != after[key]: raise RuntimeError('Unmatched initial state: ' + key)
    comparisons.append(dict(case=before['case'], idle_cycles=before['idle_cycles'],
                            before=before['core_cycles'], after=after['core_cycles']))
result = dict(scope='Fresh simulation per workload/delay; normal boot, packets, full RGB565/D24 oracle and fence; no SDRAM backdoor or signal writes',
              driver_sha256=hashlib.sha256(DRIVER.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), reports=reports, comparisons=comparisons)
(HERE / 'isolated-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(comparisons, indent=2))
